llm_response.reason: The website mimics the branding of a legitimate boutique ('The Are'), uses a recently registered domain (May 2025), and is registered in China while targeting a Spanish-speaking audience. There are no functional hyperlinks, and no verifiable company information, contact details, or social proof are present. These are all strong indicators of a fake online shopping scam targeting unsuspecting customers. Several scam website characteristics are matched, including brand mimicry, ambiguous privacy, psychological sales tactics, and lack of verifiable business operation.
